question: As a CS first-year, I want to take both 15-112 (Section W: Tue/Thu/Sun 11:30–12:45) and 15-440 (Distributed Systems) in Fall 2025. Section W of 15-440 meets Sunday 11:30–12:20. Would these two sections conflict?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-112 Section W meets Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday 11:30–12:45, and 15-440 Section W meets Sunday 11:30–12:20. Both courses share Sunday 11:30, creating a conflict. Note: 15-440 Section 3 (Tuesday/Sunday 08:30–09:45) would not conflict with 15-112. Also, P-001 likely does not meet the prerequisites for 15-440 yet (needs 15-213 or similar), so this is a hypothetical schedule check.
reasoning_type: Section-specific conflict detection with alternative section identification
common_mistake: Not checking all sections before declaring a conflict; failing to note that a different section of 15-440 avoids the conflict
needs_verification: Confirm 15-440 Section 3 Fall 2025: Tue/Sun 08:30–09:45 (potential conflict-free option)
Confirm P-001 does NOT yet meet the prerequisites for 15-440 (this is a schedule-only question)
